title: chown -J record
description: One file processed by `chown -J`, where `chown -v` (or with -c alone, `chown -c`) would print a line. Error records are in the same stream. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

path.description: The file acted on, as named on the command line or below it.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

status.description: `changed` or `retained` (`-v`: 'changed ownership of', 'retained as'); `failed`: the change was refused; `inaccessible`: the file could not be reached.

changed.description: Whether the file was changed (`status` is `changed`).

uid.description: The owner's user ID after (or, when `failed` or `inaccessible`, the one asked for).

gid.description: The group ID after (or, when `failed` or `inaccessible`, the one asked for).

error.description: An error record: the structured twin of a diagnostic the tool also printed on standard error, in order with the other records.
The diagnostic as printed on standard error, without the `tool: ` prefix.

path.description: The file the diagnostic names first, as given.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

errno.description: The system error number, when the diagnostic ends with its message (2 for `No such file or directory`).
